title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-21
lineage: CD -> Cool Edit Pro v2.0 -> Samplitude Professional v9.12 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’73 show with a monster Playin’ sandwich, back‑to‑back Looks Like Rain/Here Comes Sunshine and a soaring Dark Star jam.
ai_review.review: This recording is widely praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard mix – the guitars, keyboards and vocals sit perfectly together, making it one of the best‑sounding 1973 tapes. The performance itself is fire‑hot: a uniquely arranged Playin’ in the Band sandwich, tight rhythm work, brilliant Jerry solos and an inspirational Dark Star jam keep the energy at a sustained high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (17/19) give 5 stars, highlighting both an outstanding musical show and excellent soundboard quality; only two outliers provide low scores for unrelated reasons.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently described as crisp, clean and well‑balanced. Jerry’s guitar, Bob’s rhythm work and Keith’s keys are clear; a few notes mention the bass slightly recessed in the mix but overall the remaster by Charlie Miller is considered top‑tier.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band sandwich (Half Step → Playing → El Paso → Playing → Dark Star Jam → Wharf Rat → Playing → Morning Dew)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A creative, flowing setlist that weaves the Playin’ sandwich through several movements and pairs rain‑themed numbers back‑to‑back, keeping momentum high from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for a ‘melting‑face‑off’ solo, beautiful tone and powerful lead throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as slightly low in the mix but otherwise solid; no major performance complaints.
band_member_comments.Bob: His rhythm guitar work (especially on Wharf Rat) is described as tight with just the right amount of phasing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s contributions highlighted, particularly during Goin' Down the Road and the Playin’ sandwich jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum foundation is called tight; the band’s overall groove is praised.
